findings.text: The new `args` type breaks the in-process tool (`mcp__local__item`): `Servex/agents/tools.js:601` turns any array `type` into `z.union([object, boolean])`, so with `page_tools.js:1911` `type: ["object","array","string","number","boolean"]` the local server now rejects `args: "c1"` (`remove`), `args: ["a","b"]` (`order`), numbers, and JSON text before `parse_args` ever runs. Checked with the real converter and zod: `{title}` passes; `"c1"`, `["a","b"]`, `2` and `'{"title":"x"}'` all fail.

The root cause is in the same converter: before this diff, an untyped `args` fell through to `z.string()` (`tools.js:605`). That is why the local tool's schema shows `args` as a string, and why the client sent JSON text in the first place. The simpler fix is to make `zod()` map an untyped or multi-type property to `z.any()` (or a union that includes string, array and number). Keep `parse_args` as the safety net.

`page_call`'s `args` (`page_tools.js:1845`) is untyped too, so on the local server it is also `z.string()` and has the same bug: `page_call(..., "add", {...})` arrives as JSON text. Nothing in the diff parses it. Fix it in the converter (finding 2), or run `parse_args` there as well.

The test can't catch findings 1–3: `item-verbs.test.mjs` 3b calls `run_item` directly and skips the schema. Add one check that pushes `args` (an object, a string id, an array) through `server(...)`'s zod shape, or through `page_tools().find(t => t.name === "item").inputSchema` via the same `zod()` (the test passes, 13 checks, in worktree/item-args).
`parse_args` sits between the "THE THREE VERBS" block comment and `verbs_to_delta` (`page_tools.js:1230-1241`), so that comment now sits above the wrong function. Move the helper above the comment.

The task folder holds only `requirements.md` and `review/`: no task.jsonl, outcome or commit link. A fresh agent can find the work only through `git worktree list` (worktree/item-args, 064d5769e). Add the branch and the commit to requirements.md, or log them on the task.

Docs are current: `Servex/doc/item-tool.md` describes `parse_args`. Nothing new is unindexed (no new files). Once finding 2 is fixed, add one line to item-tool.md saying the local server's schema is built by `tools.js` `zod()`.

answer.reply: fixed: bb82ed805. The converter now lives in Servex/agents/zod_of.js: a type list is a union of exactly those kinds, so args takes an object, string, array, number or boolean.
fixed: bb82ed805. A field with no type is z.any(), not z.string(); parse_args stays as a safety net.
fixed: bb82ed805. page_call's untyped args is now any, and its handler runs parse_args too.
fixed: zod_of.test.mjs (9 checks) pushes an object, a string id, an array, a number, a boolean and JSON text through the real schema, and checks task and string fields are unchanged.
fixed: parse_args moved above the THREE VERBS comment.
